notes.title: A HAUNTED HISTORY (UNEXPECTED EVENT)
notes.notes:
A Haunted History is a horror game that is in production by The Vision team. After two years creating this story, we have the pleasure to announce that the first chapter of the story will be finally available (27/05/2022) to play. However, there's still a long path forward until this masterpiece is finished.

A Haunted History is a survival horror, which focus mainly in the story. In the game, the player initially controls Elisa and has the objective to look for her mom that desapeared mysteriously. Figure everything out by exploring the scenario, looking for clues and solving puzzles, along with some... bizarre experiences.
